repo_notes.content: LANGUAGE REQUIREMENT: Write the entire wiki in Simplified Chinese (简体中文), including page titles, headings, body text, table contents, diagram captions and the 'Sources' / 'Relevant source files' labels. Do NOT translate code, commands, class names, method names, configuration keys, file paths or URLs. Keep proper nouns in English (e.g. Sentinel, Dashboard, FlowRule, DegradeRule, SystemRule, SphU, Slot Chain, Token Server); on first occurrence on a page you may add a short Chinese explanation in parentheses, e.g. FlowRule（流控规则）. Mermaid diagram node identifiers must stay as the real code symbols.
repo_notes.author: Ethan

repo_notes.content: Sentinel is Alibaba's flow-control, circuit-breaking and system adaptive protection framework for microservices, built as a Maven multi-module Java project. Modules: sentinel-core (Entry API, Context, ProcessorSlotChain, statistics via LeapArray/StatisticNode, rule managers), sentinel-extension (dynamic rule data sources: file, Nacos, ZooKeeper, Apollo, Redis; @SentinelResource AspectJ annotation support; parameter/hot-spot flow control), sentinel-transport (CommandCenter and HeartbeatSender implementations), sentinel-adapter (Servlet, Dubbo, Apache Dubbo, gRPC, Reactor, Spring WebFlux, API gateway common, Zuul, Spring Cloud Gateway), sentinel-cluster (token client, token server, cluster protocol), sentinel-dashboard (Spring Boot backend + AngularJS frontend), sentinel-demo (runnable examples) and sentinel-benchmark (JMH benchmarks).
repo_notes.author: Ethan
